summary: Kisatchie National Forest tower built by the CCC in 1935; a fire and observation lookout 1941-1945 during Camp Livingston; removed in the early 1980s; registered 2011. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: 100-foot steel Aermotor LS-40 tower with 7x7-foot cab

events.note: Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps (CCC)
Used both as a fire lookout and an observation tower from 1941 to 1945, the period of construction, occupation and closure of U.S. Army Camp Livingston
Registered April 4, 2011; nominated by Mark H. Gutzman

notes_for_editor: Parish conflict left open, not resolved. The Forest Lookouts list says Grant Parish, which matches the brief's record; the FFLS register page says Sabine Parish. The story reports both. Editor to decide which the record should show. Brief's coordinates and elevation (78.6 m) match the register's 258 ft (79 m). The register's 100-foot height gives height_m 30.5. The removal date is only 'early 1980s' in the one source that gives it. The 2011 report mentions historic photos that accompanied the nominations; no photo URL was found, so none is listed. A Wikipedia Louisiana list page that was read has no row starting with 'Clear Creek'. A search snippet points to National Park Service material on CCC towers at Kisatchie; it does not name this tower and was not used.
